title: The Unknown Room
opening_narrative: You wake up on a cold stone floor, with no memory of how you got here. You are in a small stone room with a closed wooden box, a rock, and a door.

body.description: A mobile body with hands, able to carry up to one inventory unit.

room-one.name: Stone room
room-one.description: A small stone room with a closed wooden box, a rock, and a door.

room-two.name: Second room
room-two.description: A second stone room. Another closed door stands ahead, and the first door leads back.

outside.name: Outside
outside.description: Fresh air. You have escaped both rooms.

lock-one.name: Door lock
lock-one.description: A silver-colored metal lock fitted to the door.

lock-two.name: Second door lock
lock-two.description: A brass-colored metal lock fitted to the second door.

box.name: Box
box.description: A small wooden box with a tightly stuck lid.
box.broken_description: The shattered remains of the wooden box. Its contents are exposed.

sleep.description: Rest where you are to recover from tiredness.
